audit.why: FAVOURED / 4/10 fits 57.14% over 182 games with Swain owning only levels 1-2.
audit.corrected: Left at FAVOURED, 4/10. report[14].t's '57% WR' matches the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike says Demonic Ascension 'fears you with the recast'.
audit.why: There is no fear in Swain's kit. The recast is Demonflare: a nova that decimates and SLOWS. Highlander is immune to slows, so Yi's level 6 answers the recast outright — the real threat is the drain sustain plus Ravenous Flock turning souls into permanent max health.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rewritten around the 120s drain, the Demonflare slow, Highlander's slow immunity and the need for Grievous Wounds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nevermove is labelled '(W)' in spikes[0].text, early, mid, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0]. The full layer calls his ult 'Battle of the Immortals' in winCon and dontsFull[0].d. breakdown.early puts his E range at 725.
audit.why: Nevermove is E (850 range, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s); W is Vision of Empire. The ult is Demonic Ascension — Battle of the Immortals is not in his kit. Nevermove roots on the RETURN pass, which is why sidestepping the outbound wave is not enough, and it cancels a Meditate channel.
audit.corrected: Slot letters fixed, real ult name used, 850 range and the return-pass root stated, Meditate cancel added.

edits.before: Swain out-pokes you levels 1-2 with Death's Hand (Q) bolts and can root you with Nevermove (W) into a Q burst. But by level 3-4 your Alpha Strike (Q) dodges the airborne Nevermove and your sustained shred out-damages his mana-hungry poke, so the lane starts leaning to you if you sidestep his W.
edits.after: Swain out-pokes you levels 1-2 with Death's Hand (Q) bolts and roots you with Nevermove (E) into a Q burst - and it roots on the RETURN pass, not on the way out. By level 3-4 Alpha Strike (Q) untargets through it and your shred out-damages his poke, so the lane leans to you.

edits.before: Swain's Demonic Ascension (R) heals him and fears you with the recast, which can save him from your all-in, but at 6 your Highlander (R) speed and Meditate (W) sustain let you stick through the ult and out-DPS his drain if you kill him before the heal snowballs. Force the fight before he stacks health.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension (R) drains everyone near him on a flat 120s, and the Demonflare recast slows rather than fears - Highlander (R) is immune to slows, so you walk straight through it. Stick and out-DPS the drain, and bring Grievous Wounds, because Ravenous Flock (P) turns souls into permanent max health.

edits.before: Swain wins the first two levels with Death's Hand (Q) poke and the threat of a Nevermove (W) root into burst, so respect his mana and don't feed him free trades. Farm safe and hold Alpha Strike (Q) to dodge his W.
edits.after: Swain wins the first two levels with Death's Hand (Q) poke and the threat of a Nevermove (E) root into burst, so respect his mana and don't feed free trades. Farm safe, and never Meditate inside his 850 E range - the root cancels the channel.

edits.before: From level 3 onward the lane turns to you: Alpha Strike sidesteps Nevermove, your sustained shred out-damages his mana-limited poke, and by 4-6 Highlander (R) plus Meditate (W) let you stick and kill him before his R heal snowballs.
edits.after: From level 3 onward the lane turns to you: Alpha Strike untargets through Nevermove (E) on its 10-12s, your shred out-damages his mana-limited poke, and by 4-6 Highlander (R) plus Meditate (W) let you kill him before his R drain snowballs.

edits.before: Dodge Nevermove (W) root with Alpha Strike untargetability
edits.after: Dodge Nevermove (E) root with Alpha Strike untargetability

edits.before: Land Nevermove (W) root into a Death's Hand (Q) burst
edits.after: Land Nevermove (E) root into a Death's Hand (Q) burst

edits.before: Use Demonic Ascension (R) heal and fear to survive your all-in
edits.after: Use Demonic Ascension (R) drain heal to survive your all-in

edits.before: Farm safely through levels 1-5 with Alpha Strike and Wuju autos, never walking into E range, then once your first on-hit item is online use Q to phase through his E-root and burst him before Battle of the Immortals (R) can heal him back. Wit's End and your true-damage E shred his drain tankiness, and Highlander resets let you collapse the moment he commits.
edits.after: Farm safely through levels 1-5 with Alpha Strike and Wuju autos, never walking into E range, then once your first on-hit item is online use Q to phase through his E-root and burst him before Demonic Ascension (R) drains him back up. Wit's End and your true-damage E shred his drain tankiness, Grievous Wounds cuts his soul heals, and Highlander resets let you collapse the moment he commits.

edits.before: Track his E (Nevermove) — it's a slow-traveling skillshot on roughly a 12-13s cooldown early; when it's down he has no lockdown and you can all-in freely.
edits.after: Track Nevermove (E) — 12s at rank 1 down to 10s, and it roots on the way back rather than the way out; when it's down he has no lockdown and you can all-in freely.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 belong to Swain — his Q out-ranges your autos and a single E → W root-bomb chunks you for nothing in return. Do not contest; use Alpha Strike on the wave to farm safely and keep yourself out of E range (around 725 units). You're not trying to win these levels, only to reach 6 even.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 belong to Swain — his Q out-ranges your autos and a single E → W root-bomb chunks you for nothing in return. Do not contest; use Alpha Strike on the wave to farm safely and stay out of E range (850 units, and it roots on the return pass). You're not trying to win these levels, only to reach 6 even.

edits.before: Never trade autos while standing in Battle of the Immortals — every tick heals him and stacks souls, turning a winnable duel into his comeback.
edits.after: Never trade autos inside Demonic Ascension — every drain tick heals him, and Ravenous Flock turns souls into permanent max health, so buy Grievous Wounds first.

notes: Two fabrications killed: 'Battle of the Immortals' (his ult is Demonic Ascension) and the claim that the ult recast fears — Demonflare decimates and slows, which Highlander is outright immune to, so this is a point in Yi's favour the page was getting backwards. Nevermove was also labelled W in five content strings; it is E. The packet suspectName on wants.foe[2] is a false positive: 'Demonic Ascension' is the correct name. Level chart matches the packet, no chart edits.
